overview_description.description:
AppHarbor is a .NET Platform-as-a-Service. Developers push code to AppHarbor using either Git or Mercurial. AppHarbor then builds the code and runs any unit tests. If everything checks out, the code is deployed to AppHarbor's scalable cloud platform.

AppHarbor lets developers spend their time coming up with ideas and developing applications, not patching servers, worrying about deployment, messing with configuration files, or scaling.

product.name: PaaS Hosting
product.description: A platform-as-a-service offering that allows developers to deploy .NET applications to a scalable cloud environment.

product.name: MSSQL/MySQL Add-ons
product.description: Database add-ons that provide managed MSSQL and MySQL databases for applications hosted on AppHarbor.

product.name: WebSocket Support
product.description: Support for WebSocket connections, enabling real-time communication for applications.

product.name: CPU Throttling
product.description: A feature that manages CPU usage across worker threads to ensure consistent performance.

product.name: Librato Integration
product.description: Integration with Librato for monitoring and analyzing application performance metrics.

product.name: Trace Logging
product.description: A logging feature that allows applications to log trace messages using the .NET framework's built-in tracing capabilities.
